category_title: Year 7 pupils who respond to public reprimands by staying quiet and to stamps by working harder
scenario_title: Response to public reprimands and sanctions during task-based work
minimal_context: The student is in a whole class setting, expected to answer questions correctly on a task-based worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, please focus on answering the questions correctly on your worksheet. I am giving a verbal warning to anyone not attending to the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops talking and sits quietly, but does not work hard on the questions.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You haven't written anything. If you don't complete this, you will be disallowed from going on the school trip.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does even less work, pushing the paper away.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am telling you off in front of the class right now. You need to pick up your pen and work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays completely quiet and withdraws, showing their response to the teacher is at stake due to the public admonishment.)
